scope.summary: Reoriented the browser operator dashboard around governed Oracle workflows, removed routed repository-development surfaces and the Orrery implementation/dependencies/wiring, repaired pairing visibility and recovery, tightened browser action gates and UI truthfulness, and repaired every regression exposed by the full hosted CI gate.
out_of_scope: production Oracle services and versions beyond the hosted Oracle FREE 23ai lane
a live browser-to-Oracle pairing/action/SSE run against an operator-supplied database
maintainer-only CI-lane API support for external library embedders

entry_points.name: oraclemcp dashboard pairing form and one-time handshake
entry_points.trace: The final cargo test --workspace --all-targets gate passed, including the pairing form, uniform pairing-error HTML, one-time handshake, browser-origin, Workbench fail-closed, and quoted-source identity tests.

entry_points.name: served dashboard end-user routes and browser Workbench release gate
entry_points.trace: With Node 22.17.0 and npm 10.9.4 after npm ci, npm run check passed TypeScript, production build/SBOM/bundle checks, 20 test files and 160 tests; npm run test:e2e:dashboard passed all 3 Chromium workflows, and the full e2e command passed those 3 with 2 explicitly live-server-gated skips.

entry_points.name: browser SQL action policy and change-proposal classification
entry_points.trace: The final pinned and floating-nightly workspace all-target tests passed. The classifier regression suite pins comment-tolerant EDITIONABLE/NONEDITIONABLE stored-unit prefixes at DDL while edition-qualified VIEW stays pure DDL and dangerous bodies remain Forbidden.

entry_points.name: full local and hosted qualification
entry_points.trace: Local fmt, workspace clippy -D warnings, workspace all-target tests, cargo deny, architecture fitness, honesty, workflow supply-chain, dashboard bundle, and changed-line coverage gates passed. Coverage against d90bd808204726acd699982aec465fc490af8d1a was oraclemcp 1/1 (100.0%), core 91/92 (98.9%), and guard 35/35 (100.0%); the mutation leg was explicitly deferred under the existing train policy, not claimed as passed. Hosted CI run 30336523033 on the exact source SHA completed success with 23/23 jobs and zero failures.

limitations: Hosted CI exercised Oracle FREE 23ai and VECTOR smoke, but did not connect the browser dashboard itself to an operator-supplied live Oracle service.
The two Playwright tests that require an explicitly configured live oraclemcp server were skipped; all three self-contained shipped-dashboard browser tests passed.

React Doctor improved from 48 to 74 with no errors and 40 remaining warnings; the two cache-invalidation warnings are on-demand read operations, while the remainder is legacy file-size/export/performance maintainability debt rather than a newly asserted green gate.

Repository Rule 1 forbids deleting a tracked file without an exact deletion command, so web/src/app/orrery-renderer.tsx remains as an inert three-line module; the renderer implementation, imports, dependencies, skin registry, and view-model wiring are absent and lint-gated.
